messages:
noah_sales: Heads up 70min call with an EU payments customer. They need clarity: can Redwood ensure inbound requests, model inference, and logs stay within the EU for a hosted POC? Also want the current subprocessors and to see how fallback/routing works if eu capacity is saturated. Any quick answers?

amelia_se: We can offer an EU-preferring hosted endpoint for trials. For an absolute contractual guarantee that nothing leaves the EU, we recommend Dedicated or Private. For the POC we usually do hosted with X-Region pinning + smoke tests to validate locality.

vikram_eng: Technical: routing uses policy layers. Sequence: route to same-region pool -> if no capacity, try compatible model variant in-region -> if still unavailable and policy allows, fallback to nearest region. You can set strict routing flags to fail rather than fallback. Example client header: `X-Region: eu-central-1` and `routingStrict=true`.

vikram_eng: Note: strict routing=true will cause requests to return 429/503 if no EU capacity, it won't automatically cross-region. That is available on Dedicated and can be enabled for hosted in many cases but may require ops approval for safety.

amelia_se: Subprocessor list is sharable under NDA. It includes EU cloud provider regions, CDN in eu-west, logging provider (can be configured), and monitoring tools. If they demand that all tooling be EU-resident, we should propose Dedicated with EU-only subprocessors.

noah_sales: Liz, legal wants a single-sentence we can put in the questionnaire: "Does data leave the EU?" They need a yes/no.

liz_legal: Can't give a plain yes/no for hosted multi-tenant. Suggest: "For hosted EU-prefixed deployments we route and process inference and associated request logs within EU regions by default. Under capacity constraints, and unless strict routing is contracted, requests may fall back to compatible regions. Customers requiring a contractual guarantee of EU-only processing should engage Dedicated or Private deployments." Use that wording in the questionnaire.

noah_sales: Perfect. Customer also asked: will analytics/metrics ever be sent to US services?

vikram_eng: Aggregated metrics are routed to our global telemetry pipeline for alerting; raw request logs live in-region and are access-controlled. For full in-region telemetry and key management, Dedicated/Private + customer-managed KMS is the path.

amelia_se: Pricing: hosted EU-pin for POC = standard hosted rates. If they want guaranteed EU-only SLA or dedicated capacity, we add a Dedicated month commitment. For a short trial we can offer a 1-month reserved pool with a modest uplift (typical range 8-12%) to cover isolated capacity scheduling. I'll estimate once they give QPS and expected token volume.

noah_sales: They also want a short validation test plan so they can prove to compliance that nothing left-region. Can we provide steps?

vikram_eng: I'll produce a simple test plan: 1) set X-Region and strict routing flag. 2) send sample requests with unique identifiers. 3) verify request traces and storage bucket locations (we'll provide signed access to logs). 4) run a forced capacity test (burst) to confirm strict routing results in 5xx rather than cross-region. I'll attach config snippet and log path examples.

liz_legal: Also include subprocessor disclosure and an SOW paragraph that covers routing policy and remediation if we inadvertently process outside EU. I can draft liability language for the SOW.

noah_sales: Action items: 1) amelia - request sanitized subprocessor list + quick hosted EU pin instructions (ETA today 18:00 CET). 2) vikram - produce test plan + config snippet (ETA EOD). 3) liz - draft the questionnaire reply sentence + SOW paragraph (ETA tomorrow morning). 4) amelia - ballpark uplift for 1-month Dedicated EU pool (need QPS).

infra-bot: Notice: eu-central-1 hosted pool scale-up completed at 1769464300.

amelia_se: I'll send the sanitized subprocessors link and the quick config in the next message, will cc legal.

vikram_eng: Quick config example: `{ "region": "eu-central-1", "routingStrict": true }` and sample curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Region: eu-central-1" -H "X-Routing-Strict: 1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond`

noah_sales: Amazing. I'll run this with the customer tomorrow and capture their compliance checklist. Thanks team.

amelia_se: Ack.

liz_legal: A couple wording tweaks and I'll post the SOW paragraph in the doc repo.

noah_sales: Closing notes: customer seemed amenable to a 1-month Dedicated POC if we can get pricing and SOW sorted quickly. Keep updates here.

amelia_se: Will do.

vikram_eng: I'll attach the validation steps to the ticket once drafted.

noah_sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:
